description: A script for managing build tasks, dependencies, and caching within the Notesnook project. It handles command-line arguments, resolves package dependencies, computes file checksums, and executes npm scripts accordingly.

methods.name: findPkgs
methods.description: Finds all package directories matching the configured project paths that contain a package.json file.

methods.name: readPkg
methods.description: Reads and caches the package.json content of a given package path.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from a given path.

methods.name: getPkgName
methods.description: Retrieves the package name from package.json or defaults to the directory name.

methods.name: isPkg
methods.description: Checks if a given path corresponds to a package with a specific name.

methods.name: findDeps
methods.description: Recursively finds all dependencies (filtered to @notesnook/* with file: links) for a given package.

methods.name: resolvePkg
methods.description: Resolves the script commands and dependencies for a package that has the specified npm script.

methods.name: runScript
methods.description: Executes an npm script in a package directory, with optional verbose output and arguments.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path by resolving and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: toBatches
methods.description: Creates execution batches based on package dependencies to avoid cyclic execution.

methods.name: resolveRecursive
methods.description: Recursively resolves all dependencies for a package and script, avoiding cycles.

methods.name: computeChecksumFast
methods.description: Computes a fast checksum of a directory based on file paths, mtimes, and sizes.

methods.name: computeChecksumSlow
methods.description: Computes a slow checksum of a directory based on file contents.

methods.name: findKeyInObject
methods.description: Recursively searches for a key in an object.

methods.name: getBuildFolder
methods.description: Determines the build output folder for a package based on package.json fields.
